tools.name: extract_key_phrases
tools.description:
Statistical key-phrase extraction — top-N ranked phrases.

Brainiall Key Phrases engine. Pure-statistical (TF + position + casing + stopword filter), no ML cost.

tools.name: aspect_sentiment
tools.description:
Sentiment per aspect. Brainiall Aspect Sentiment engine.

Splits the text into sentences mentioning each aspect, classifies each, aggregates.

tools.name: classify_text_custom
tools.description:
Zero-shot text classification — define your labels at call time. No training, no data upload.

Brainiall Custom Classifier engine. Returns {top_label, scores, confidence}.

Brainiall Entity Linker engine. Disambiguates 'Apple' the company from 'apple' the fruit.

tools.name: detect_conversational_pii
tools.description:
Multi-turn PII detection with cross-turn coreference.

Brainiall Conversational PII engine. Same surface text + type across turns gets the same entity_id.

tools.name: detect_prompt_injection
tools.description:
Classify a prompt before it reaches your LLM. Brainiall Prompt Shield engine.

Returns category (jailbreak | prompt_injection | data_exfiltration | impersonation | none),
severity, reason, confidence.

tools.name: check_groundedness
tools.description:
Hallucination check: is a claim actually supported by a source text?

Brainiall Groundedness engine. Returns {grounded, confidence, supporting_span, reason}.

tools.name: detect_protected_material
tools.description:
Detect copyrighted text in user input — famous lyrics, literary openings, proprietary code.

Brainiall Protected Material engine. Returns matched spans with source attribution.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "knowledge_query" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Retrieve the most relevant passages from a knowledge base plus (optionally) a grounded, cited answer. Returns found:false rather than a guess when the passages …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: detect_pii, fraud_score · Private data: answer_question, knowledge_ingest, knowledge_list_documents · Public sink: detect_pii, fraud_score, classify_text_custom.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: detect_pii, fraud_score · Private data: answer_question, knowledge_ingest, knowledge_list_documents · Public sink: detect_pii, fraud_score, classify_text_custom

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
